govdocs-archive_org-nsia-AutopsyJFKMorga: This Washington Post item — Dr. Russell H. Morgan on the JFK Autopsy X-Rays — is a press piece on the disputed evidence. The X-rays remain controversial. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of press history.
